subject: Pin workflow pip/go/npm dependencies for OpenSSF compliance (#3276)
reason: The change pins pip/go/npm dependency versions in GitHub Actions workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml) and the reply-schema-linter's package.json/package-lock.json for OpenSSF compliance. It is purely a CI/build-infrastructure change: no Valkey server code, command behaviour, replication, persistence, or bundled tool is modified, so no fuzzer scenario can exercise it and none is needed.
